Transport Modes

شاحنة ستائر

A commercial road vehicle with flexible, retractable side curtains for rapid side-loading and unloading, used for general cargo and referenced in CMR waybills and loading instructions.

Definition

A commercial road vehicle with flexible, retractable side curtains for rapid side-loading and unloading, used for general cargo and referenced in CMR waybills and loading instructions.

Operational example

The curtain truck allows fast side-loading of palletized goods, making it suitable for cross-docking as stated on the CMR waybill.
